messages:
carlos: Noticed oddity on latency dashboard for /v1/generate: p50/p95 flat but p99 jumps on endpoint "sidebar-summary" after routing tweak. anyone else?
mei: saw it. only the endpoint breakdown for that subroute shows the spike. sample_count for that slice fell from ~200 -> 8 at the same time.
tom: likely small-sample noise + routing change that sent a handful through proxy-c. those add ~300ms transport.
carlos: consoles currently label percentiles by endpoint only. could be confusing when origin changes.
mei: quick patch idea: show "percentile provenance" in tooltip: origin breakdown and sample_count. also display a confidence flag when N<50.
anya: +1. UX: when someone hovers p99 show top-3 raw samples and origin tags. super quick and helps triage.
tom: telemetry ask: expose query param origin= to the percentile API so we can request endpoint?origin=backend and compare. makes automation easier.
obs-bot: TelemetryTask created: T-99001 - expose per-origin percentiles API.
carlos: rollout UI note: include a confidence blurb when changing routing weights that may flip small cohorts. "When route weight changes >2% for a cohort with N<100, expect percentile variance."
mei: also suggest we mute high-severity p99 alerts for slices with N<30 by default. noisy pages are killing ops.
tom: agreed. i'll PR alerting change to degrade severity based on sample_count.
carlos: added repro curl snippet in the issue to generate synthetic fallback traffic. will follow up with numbers after we roll the tooltip change.
anya: i'll draft the UI copy and a short help doc explaining sample bias for percentiles.
carlos: thanks all, i'll watch the staging dashboard once tooltip patch lands.
